packageRules.description: `cli` is published to npm, so its runtime `dependencies` are what consumers resolve against. The shared preset pins every range, which would lock dependents to one exact version and clash with anything else in their tree that needs a different one. `replace` keeps the caret ranges and only opens a PR when a release falls outside them. Everything else stays pinned: the root app is private, and `cli`’s `devDependencies` never reach consumers.
